bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears improved to 7-2 and seized sole possession of first place in the NFC North, climbing to the No. 2 seed in the NFC playoff picture after Minnesota's loss to Buffalo over the weekend, with Chicago now using its bye week to address a sputtering ground game under head coach Ben Johnson.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions acquired safety Andre Cisco from the New York Jets just before the NFL trade deadline, announcing Monday that they have agreed to trade terms with the New York Jets to acquire S Andre Cisco in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round draft selection , a move made necessary since Kerby Joseph was working his way back from a knee injury . Despite reportedly not landing a bigger defensive upgrade at the deadline, Kerby Joseph won't play in Germany as the Lions prepare for their upcoming matchup.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story out of Green Bay today centers on star pass rusher Micah Parsons, who was back on the practice field going through team drills, with coach Matt LaFleur saying he looks great but confirming he will not play against the Vikings . Instead, Parsons is reportedly targeting the Packers' Week 12 matchup against the Los Angeles Rams on Nov.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings, now 6-2 and fighting for the NFC North and a Wild Card spot, made a blockbuster move by trading a 2027 third-round pick to the Las Vegas Raiders to reacquire quarterback Kirk Cousins, as they pulled the trigger ahead of the NFL trade deadline to boost their playoff push . Heading into Sunday's game at Green Bay, head coach Kevin O'Connell confirmed that linebacker Blake Cashman is in concussion protocol , adding to injury concerns that include quarterback Carson Wentz's ankle and safety Jay Ward's knee, both of whom would have been limited participants had Wednesday been a practice session .
